text:
Elaine: Quick sync — planning to flip feature flag `prefetch_batch_v2` to 10% canary TOMORROW 10:00 PT for latency wins on small requests. Posting plan + validation checklist here.
Igor: Can you drop the perf numbers you're expecting? Is this mostly tail-latency or p50 improvements?
Elaine: Mostly tail (95/99). In internal testing we saw ~18% p99 reduction for <512-token requests. p50 unchanged.
Meera: What are the guardrails? If we see error rates up or latency spikes what's immediate action?
Sam: I pushed a rollout config PR: `infra/flags/prefetch_batch_v2.yaml` — it includes audience, per-route caps and an auto-disable rule. Example snippet:```yaml
flag: prefetch_batch_v2
audience:
  percent: 10
  selectors:
    - route_prefix: "/api/generate"
    - tenant_allowlist: ["tenant-alpha", "tenant-beta"]
constraints:
  max_input_tokens: 512
  max_batch_size: 32
fallback: prefetch: false
auto_disable:
  error_rate_threshold: 1.5% # disable if errors > 1.5% over 5m
  latency_regression_ms: 200 # disable if p99 increases by >200ms
```
Sam: CI passed for config tests, but still needs one approver for infra/flags.
deploy-bot: CI: infra/flags checks — ✅ all tests passed (build 4128).
Igor: Add a quick perf job to run during canary: `tools/bench --profile prefetch_v2 --routes /api/generate --qps 30 --duration 10m` and compare p99 vs baseline. I'll add a dashboard panel to compare baseline/canary.
Toby: Oncall — please standby 09:45–11:30 PT. If anything looks off we should rollback immediately. Also please ensure alert routing is to eng-runtime oncall.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Eng runtime oncall assigned to @toby today. Alerting policy: `prefetch_batch_v2-canary` created with thresholds for 5m error rate and p99 latency.
Meera: Suggest we stagger by route and tenant to reduce blast radius. e.g., start with route /api/generate/text and tenant-alpha only, then expand to others after 1h stable.
Sam: I'll update the YAML to split audiences into two steps and add a cron job that ramps from 10% -> 25% after one hour if metrics stable. Also adding a rollout note in the PR body with rollback steps.
Elaine: Nice. Can you paste rollback commands? Keep them short.
Sam: Rollback is two commands: `redwood-ctl feature disable prefetch_batch_v2 --env prod` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --selector=ff=prefetch_batch_v2` (if we need to flush caches).
Igor: Also add a trace sampling tweak so we can see KV cache hits in canary traces: set `trace.sample.rate=0.5` for the canary group.
Meera: I'll own post-mortem template in case things go sideways and prepare a short prompt test suite to catch quality regressions.
Elaine: Thanks all — tagging reviewers: @Sam @Igor please merge before 08:30 PT so infra can apply and we can start rollout at 10:00. Ping here once merged. :thumbsup:
Sam: Merged the PR and added the rollout checklist in PR body. Kicking off an initial perf run now. :rocket:
Igor: Baseline run complete, uploading graphs to the dashboard. Will post p99 numbers in ~12m.
Sam: :thumbsup:
